description: This file implements the service layer for managing client collateral data within the FinExAreT application, including adding, updating, and deleting collateral products associated with clients.

classes.name: ClientCollateralManagementWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service to manage client collateral operations such as add, update, and delete within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: addClientCollateralProduct
methods.description: Adds a new collateral product for a client after validating input parameters.

methods.name: validateForCreation
methods.description: Validates command parameters to ensure they exist and are correct before creating a new client collateral record.

methods.name: updateClientCollateralProduct
methods.description: Updates the existing client collateral record after validation.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates parameters for updating a client collateral, including quantity checks and existence validation.

methods.name: deleteClientCollateralProduct
methods.description: Deletes a client collateral product after validation that the collateral is eligible for deletion.

methods.name: validateForDeletion
methods.description: Checks that the collateral exists and is not attached to any active loans before deletion.
